skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc:
Deals 4500% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to the entire row in a 5-hit combo (affected only by advanced DMG reduction), ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrates [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

Grants permanent [Extreme Speed-Up] to allies outside the same row.

[Extreme Speed-Up]: When active, overrides [Specialized Acceleration]/[Speed Domain], increasing speed to 94% of Homeless Emperor's speed (this effect does not apply if the user's speed is higher than the amplified speed).

When dealing DMG, if the target's speed is not higher than the user's, all DMG received by the target is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Super Ultimate
skills.desc:
Increase ATK of all allies by 30% (cannot be dispelled).

Deals 6000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to the entire row in a 5-hit combo (affected only by advanced DMG reduction), ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrates [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

Grants permanent [Extreme Speed-Up] to allies outside the same row.

[Extreme Speed-Up]: When active, overrides [Specialized Acceleration]/[Speed Domain], increasing speed to 98% of Homeless Emperor's speed (this effect does not apply if the user's speed is higher than the amplified speed).

When dealing DMG, if the target's speed is not higher than the user's, all DMG received by the target is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Passive — Base
skills.desc:
At battle start, gains 80% [Specialized Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

Upon entering the battlefield, permanently inflicts [Energy Erosion] on all enemies (undispellable).

At the start of combat and after any character takes action, removes all [Specialized Speed-Up] and [normal Speed-Up] effects from all enemies.

[Specialized Non-Crit Hit DMG Reduction]: Reduces all incoming DMG from non-[Specialized Critical Hits].

[Specialized Critical Hit]: When dealing [Specialized Direct DMG], triggers a Critical Hit based on the portion of the Final Critical Rate that exceeds 200%.

[Energy Erosion]: Immune to gaining [Energy Tenacity] when taking hits; any [Energy Tenacity] gained cannot be converted into [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Awaken Passive — A1
skills.desc:
Immune to [Charm] / [Specialized Charm].

Upon entering the battlefield, grants self 60% [Extreme Speed-Up] for the first 3 turns.

For the first 3 turns, grants [Destructive Momentum: Assault] to allies with [Extreme Speed-Up].

[Destructive Momentum: Assault]: Increases the DMG bonus effect of [Extreme Speed-Up] by 0.5x, and enemies retain 50% of its current value each time they return to the field (PVP only).

skills.name: Awaken Passive — A2
skills.desc:
Immune to [Charm] / [Specialized Charm].

Upon entering the battlefield, grants self 68% [Extreme Speed-Up] for the first 3 turns.

For the first 3 turns, grants [Destructive Momentum: Assault] to allies with [Extreme Speed-Up].

For the first 3 turns, grants [Destructive Momentum: Defense] to allies with [Extreme Speed-Up].

When allies with [Extreme Speed-Up] unleash skills during the first 3 turns, energy consumption is reduced by 1.

[Destructive Momentum: Assault]: Increases the DMG bonus effect of [Extreme Speed-Up] by 1.5x, and enemies retain 50% of its current value each time they return to the field (PVP only).

[Destructive Momentum: Defense]: Reduces the DMG bonus of the enemy's [Extreme Speed-Up] by 30%.
